title: St. Monica-St. Michael Catholic School
subtitle: Washington, D.C. · May 27–30, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families are currently viewing St. Monica-St. Michael Catholic School’s sample itinerary. This version provides a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As departure nears, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C. & the Museum of American History

  • Depart for Washington, D.C. (students bring breakfast and lunch to eat en route)
  • Estimated arrival in Washington, D.C.! Meet your Landmark Leaders
  • Visit the National Museum of American History
  • Dinner allocation
  • Return to hotel accommodations with overnight security (three nights)

Day 2: Arlington National Cemetery & the Smithsonian Museums

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Visit the US Marine Corps War Memorial: Iwo Jima
  • Landmark Leader–led walking tour of Arlington National Cemetery
  • Lunch allocation
  • Visit the National Museum of African American History and Culture
  • Visit the Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History
  • Sit-down dinner
  • Visit the Thomas Jefferson, Franklin Delano Roosevelt, and MLK Memorials around the Tidal Basin
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 3: Capitol Hill & the National Mall

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Visit the Library of Congress
  • Lunch allocation
  • Public guided tour of the United States Capitol Building
  • Visit the Supreme Court Building Exhibit
  • Visit the National Archives
  • White House photo opportunity
  • Sit-down dinner
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 4: George Washington’s Mount Vernon

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Visit George Washington’s Mount Vernon Estate
  • Boxed lunch
  • Depart for home
introHeading: St. Monica-St. Michael Catholic School, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2027! 🏛️
introText: From the rows of Arlington National Cemetery to the dome of the United States Capitol, this trip brings American history and civics to life at every turn. Students will take a guided tour of the Capitol, stand before the Lincoln, Jefferson, FDR, and MLK Memorials, explore the Library of Congress, the National Archives, and the Smithsonian museums, and walk the grounds of George Washington’s Mount Vernon. It’s the perfect blend of education, exploration, and fun—an experience your students will be talking about long after the trip ends.
